original.target_description: Experiment 1, Yale undergraduate viewers; energy-performance ratings predicting President Carter’s general performance evaluation, interaction of energy performance with exposure to energy news, b2 in Equation 1.1.

n.sample_role: Participants in the Experiment 1 interaction regression; exact analytic number after exclusions not established.
n.exclusions: No target-regression exclusion count or analytic n identified. Method reports 73 completed participants; Tables 1 and 2 print no coverage n = 21 and some coverage n = 73, inconsistent with the method total. Neither total nor a sum of those headers is adopted as analytic n.
n.location: Published p. 780, Experiment 1 Method, Subjects; pp. 781–782, Tables 1 and 2; p. 782, interaction-regression result.

es.location: Published p. 782 (PDF page 5), left column, Experiment 1 Results, paragraph beginning “The results from this formal test”. Metric explained on p. 781 and Equation 1.1, pp. 781–782.

p.location: Published p. 782 (PDF page 5), left column, Experiment 1 Results, paragraph beginning “The results from this formal test”; same b2 interaction for general performance.

replication.target_description: Unassigned replication side; not examined in this original-only validation.

notes: Fresh original-only blind validation. Supplied primary published scan title and author list match the assigned original reference. Numerical result and table sample headers checked visually against PDF pages 4–5, rather than trusting embedded OCR. Locator p. 5 corresponds to published p. 782. The general-performance interaction is the uniquely significant Experiment 1 media-priming result at that locator; competence and integrity are separate tests and were not substituted. Original manuscript uses b2 for the interaction. Printed table headers really read n = 21 and n = 73; method total is 73, and the target interaction analytic n is not explicitly established. Replication and reported_success placeholders are unassigned, not claims about replication-source availability.
